# UnknownGravity

A startup focused on [[Real estate tokenization]] on blockchain, based in [[Málaga]], Spain. [[Álvaro Jiménez Martínez]] worked as the sole backend developer (Full Stack Web3 Developer) from May 2025 to December 2025. He led end-to-end architecture and development of a real-estate tokenization platform on the [[Polygon network]], resulting in a marketplace with over €2.2 million in listed property assets. Key technical contributions include database semaphores and concurrency controls for off-chain/on-chain balance synchronization, Web3.js integration, smart contract testing (Hardhat, Mocha), and CI/CD automation with GitHub Actions and Coolify on AWS.

## Technologies Used

- Node.js, PostgreSQL, React, AWS, Docker
- Web3.js, Hardhat, Mocha
- GitHub Actions, Coolify
